title: Meeting at the Busy Corner
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。这是一个模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。请先读短文，再做题。答案必须来自短文。
passage: A: It is Saturday morning. The neighbourhood is very busy. There is a new café on the corner. There are many people in the street. B: Let's meet at the café at ten. A: Good idea. But where is the café? B: It is next to the bank. A: Is there a bus stop near the café? B: Yes, there is. The bus stop is in front of the bank. A: What are the people doing? B: A woman is buying flowers. Two children are running. A man is waiting for the bus. A: Are they waiting for us? B: No, they are not. They are busy. A: OK. See you at ten. B: See you. Don't be late!

grammar.title: There is / There are；地点介词；现在进行时；祈使句入门
grammar.explanation: 1. There is / There are 表示“有”。单数用 There is，复数用 There are。例如：There is a café. There are many people. 2. 地点介词：on the corner（在拐角），next to（在……旁边），in front of（在……前面），in the street（在街上）。3. 现在进行时表示正在发生的事：am/is/are + 动词-ing。例如：A woman is buying flowers. Two children are running. 4. 祈使句表示命令或建议，动词原形开头。例如：Don't be late! Let's meet at ten.
grammar.example: There is a new café on the corner. There are many people in the street. A woman is buying flowers. Don't be late!

questions.prompt: There ______ a park near my house.
questions.explanation: a park 是单数，所以用 There is。
questions.evidence: There is a new café on the corner.

questions.prompt: There ______ two shops on the street.
questions.explanation: two shops 是复数，所以用 There are。
questions.evidence: There are many people in the street.
It is next to the bank.

questions.prompt: The bus stop is ______ of the bank.
questions.explanation: in front of 表示“在……前面”。
questions.evidence: The bus stop is in front of the bank.

questions.prompt: Look! The children ______ in the street.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时：The children 是复数，用 are + running。

questions.prompt: A man ______ for the bus now.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时：A man 是单数，用 is + waiting。
questions.evidence: A man is waiting for the bus.

questions.explanation: 否定祈使句用 Don't + 动词原形。

questions.prompt: ______ meet at the café at ten.
questions.explanation: Let's 表示“让我们”，用于提出建议。
questions.evidence: Let's meet at the café at ten.
